leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a deferred value to optimize rendering performance for slow-changing data
Apply the useDeferredValue hook to manage state updates in Angular components
Construct a search input component that uses deferred values to prevent UI blocking
Configure deferred value dependencies to control when re-renders occur
Integrate deferred values with template expressions to improve user experience
Manipulate component state to demonstrate the visual difference between immediate and deferred updates
Initialize deferred values with appropriate initial states for different data types
